meta.name: git-master
meta.description: MUST USE whenever a task needs a commit or git-history investigation. Covers atomic commits, staging, commit-message style, rebase, squash, fixup/autosquash, blame, bisect, reflog, git log -S/-G, and questions like who wrote this or when was this added. Do not use for ordinary code edits unless the user asks for git work.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理 Git 提交与历史，自动生成规范提交
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要规范提交或排查 Git 历史
copy.tagline_en: Manage Git commits and history with automated commit messages
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to make clean commits or investigate Git history

howto.what: 装上这个技能后,当涉及 git 提交或历史查询时,Claude 会先检查仓库状态,再按任务类型处理;提交时只提交你要求的改动,查询时会附上命令和证据。
howto.when: 当任务需要做 git 提交、改写历史或调查历史(如查谁改的、何时加的)时触发;普通改代码不触发,除非你明确要求做 git 操作。

say.text: 把我工作区的改动按模块分成多个提交。
say.note: Claude 会先看完整 diff,再按模块分组提交。

say.text: 查一下这份文件里第 20 到 40 行是谁最后改的。
say.note: Claude 会运行 git blame 并给出提交信息。

say.text: 把最近三个提交压缩成一个 squash 提交。
say.note: Claude 会进入 rebase 模式,重写这三条提交。

howto.what_en: When a git commit or history query is needed, Claude first checks the repository state, then handles the task by type. It commits only the requested changes and cites command evidence when answering history questions.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a task involves git commits, history rewriting (e.g., rebase, squash), or history investigation (e.g., who changed what, when added). Not triggered by ordinary code edits unless git work is explicitly requested.

say_en.text: Split my working-tree changes into multiple commits by module.
say_en.note: Claude reviews the full diff and groups by module before committing.

say_en.text: Find who last changed lines 20-40 in this file.
say_en.note: Claude runs git blame and shows the commit info.

say_en.text: Squash the last three commits into one.
say_en.note: Claude enters rebase mode and rewrites them.
